हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Prachi Radhakrishnan is publicly shattered by her cheating ex, Vikram — until a stranger, Armaan Chibber, steps in as her unlikely savior… and fake fiancé. But to the world, he’s nothing more than a gold digger chasing her wealth. As Prachi fights for Kanchiloom and her dignity, trust begins to blur and emotions run dangerously deep. With Sneha and Payal plotting their downfall, one question looms — Is Armaan a fraud… or the only truth she has left? Watch now!
